findings.title: Decode skip broader than spec allows
findings.problem: Spec section 1 'Decode' says to skip a string row only when the decoded value is not an array. _decode_credential_values also returns None, which skips the row, for an array that holds any non-object element. A test (test_decode_credential_values_returns_none_for_non_dict_element) locks this in. A skipped row hits `continue` before the alias backfill, so it stays a jsonb string and keeps a NULL alias if it had one.
findings.impact: The spec criterion is only partly met. For such a row AC1 (array plus non-empty alias) would fail and the integration would stay uneditable ('Alias is required'). Reachability is unconfirmed and very unlikely: the old c3d4e5f6a7b8 only ever json.dumps'd lists of dicts (its _merge_assistant_ids copies entries with dict(), and insert builds [{key, value}]), so no live producer of such rows was found.
findings.recommendation: Get a human decision. Either narrow `_decode_credential_values` so it skips only when the decoded value is not an array, as the spec says (and update `test_decode_credential_values_returns_none_for_non_dict_element` to match), or amend spec section 1 "Decode" to accept the stricter non-object-element skip. If the stricter skip stays, consider still backfilling the alias on skipped rows.
findings.resolution: accepted by user decision; spec amended
